testLoginHelp: Checks email and password with the values on this page, without saving
loginOk: Email and password are correct. Save and close to start the adapter.
loginFailed: The account service refused the login. Log in once in the app, then try again.
loginUnreachable: The account service did not answer. Check the internet connection of ioBroker and try again.
loginBusy: A login test is already running.
loginRejected: Email or password is wrong, or the account belongs to the other app. Check the app selection.
